[untitled BTM module] These genes sketch a morphogen-driven programme that patterns mesenchymal tissue and steers progenitors toward bone, cartilage, skin and blood-supporting fates. BMP signalling sits at its centre: SMAD1 carries the receptor signal to the nucleus, ZNF521 acts as a nuclear cofactor tuning that output in skeletal and haematopoietic progenitors, while secreted GREM1 antagonises BMP ligands to keep niches permissive, and INHBA contributes an activin/TGF-beta arm through its own receptor-SMAD route.

name: Circulating monocyte and resting dendritic cell surface signatures
members: [untitled BTM module] These genes mark the mature myeloid compartment, particularly monocytes, macrophages and neutrophils, and the secretory and degradative capabilities that make those cells useful in innate immunity and tissue remodelling. Surface ectoenzymes such as aminopeptidase N and maltase-glucoamylase digest peptides and carbohydrates at the plasma membrane, an aquaglyceroporin channel moves water and small solutes during phagocyte activation and swelling, and a secreted sulfatase edits heparan sulfate on the extracellular matrix to release bound growth factors and chemokines.
